hypothesis: M183 proves that the M182 source-diverse boundary surface can be represented as replay-aligned fixed objective data. A tiny anchored actor-coupling update from M168 strict may improve the M183 objective while preserving behavior and protected replay rows.
success_criteria: start from M168 strict before trying the split-aware M170 branch
use M183 labels only as training-time supervision and keep actor inputs unchanged
run a small actor-coupling update with strong action anchors, not PPO
improve the M183 fixed objective with very small action-anchor drift
pass behavior retention, protected-key replay, and M182/M183 boundary replay gates before any PPO
failure_criteria: train PPO before the guarded actor update passes
accept fixed objective improvement after behavior or protected-key regression
promote M170 over M168 solely because of fixed objective improvement

commands.name: m184_m168_guarded_actor_coupling_smoke
commands.command: Run outcome_intervention_optimize from M168 strict with runs/m183_m168_boundary_outcome_corpus_dedup_seed9510/boundary_outcome_corpus.npz, actor_coupling train scope, action-anchor coefficient 100, and a small step count.

commands.name: m184_behavior_and_replay_gates
commands.command: Evaluate the candidate on behavior retention, protected-key replay, and fixed M183 boundary replay before considering PPO.

decision_rule: Only a low-drift guarded actor update that preserves behavior and boundary replay may admit PPO smoke.
